cases.name: Kala May Hodgkin
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Kala was a beautiful soul, loved and respected by many. She was known for her fierce and all-encompassing love for her children, her selfless actions, and willingness to help all around her. Kala's happy place was with her children, connecting with nature; barefoot, watching the moon, hiking, and exploring. She loved spontaneous adventures and was an avid picture taker. She loved hard, felt fiercely, and danced to the beat of her own drum. Tattoos were her therapy."
cases.narrative: He allegedly shot her to death and torched her car in the driveway, leaving behind a small fire extinguisher.
